answer: Quadratic weighting makes sybil attacks expensive by reducing marginal influence. Each new identity contributes the square root of its stake, not the full amount, so ten fake accounts with 1 token each yield √1+√1+... = √10 ≈ 3.16 influence, while one real account with 10 tokens yields √10 ≈ 3.16. The attacker gains nothing by splitting. To double influence requires quadrupling stake.
